title: A Visualization Explanation of Joins in PostgreSQL
description: Understand join types visually with sample tables.

data.text: PostgreSQL supports INNER JOIN, LEFT/RIGHT OUTER JOIN, FULL OUTER JOIN, CROSS JOIN, and LATERAL joins.

data.title: Sample Tables

data.title: Tip
data.text: Use LATERAL to join set-returning functions to rows.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use LATERAL for row-wise set functions.
